note: Percentages are the maintainers' estimate of completed and verified behavior per subsystem, weighted by importance to a playable 1:1 port. They are not measured against the original game unless a row says so.

subsystems.name: Content formats
subsystems.detail: KN5 models, INI/LUT, ACD archives and car data readers. Skins, CSP extensions and some KN5 variants are missing.

subsystems.name: Rendering
subsystems.detail: wgpu renderer with diffuse, multilayer and BC textures. Original shaders, normal maps, shadows, reflections, weather and post-processing are missing.

subsystems.name: Chassis and rigid body
subsystems.detail: 6-DOF body with explicit inertia, fixed 120 Hz steps and coupled suspension solving.

subsystems.name: Suspension kinematics
subsystems.detail: DWB and STRUT raw-design geometry with constraint residuals. Setup mapping and bump stops are not calibrated.

subsystems.name: Tyre forces
subsystems.detail: Pacejka-style forces with load sensitivity, friction ellipse and relaxation length. Camber thrust, thermal and wear models are missing.

subsystems.name: Engine and drivetrain
subsystems.detail: Torque curve, gearbox timing, clutch, RWD/FWD/AWD, centre and axle differentials, flywheel coupling.

subsystems.name: Aerodynamics
subsystems.detail: Drag, front/rear lift with pitch moment and wing AoA curves. DRS and active elements are missing.

subsystems.name: Collision
subsystems.detail: Static WALL impacts with friction and certified departure. Edge/vertex contact, continuous detection and car-to-car contact are missing.

subsystems.name: Input and controls
subsystems.detail: Keyboard driving works. Gamepad and steering-wheel input are not wired in yet.

subsystems.name: Sessions and game modes
subsystems.detail: Car and track loading with spawn checks. Race rules, timing, flags and pit logic are missing.

subsystems.name: Original-game validation
subsystems.detail: Telemetry research tooling exists. No subsystem is yet verified against recordings of the original game.
